text: The iPhone 15 starts at $799 for the 128GB configuration, with 256GB and 512GB options priced higher.
The iPhone 15 has a 3349 mAh battery, rated by Apple for up to about 20 hours of video playback.
The iPhone 15 has a 6.1-inch OLED display with a 60Hz refresh rate; it does not get the 120Hz ProMotion display reserved for Pro models.
The iPhone 15 weighs about 171 grams.
The iPhone 15 runs on Apple's A16 Bionic chip, a 4nm processor also used in the previous year's iPhone 14 Pro models.
The iPhone 15 has a 48MP main camera and is the first standard (non-Pro) iPhone to include the Dynamic Island.
The Samsung Galaxy S24 starts at $799 for the base 128GB, 8GB RAM configuration in the US.
The Samsung Galaxy S24 has a 4,000 mAh battery, supporting 25W wired charging and 15W wireless charging.
The Samsung Galaxy S24 has a 6.2-inch Dynamic AMOLED 2X display with an adaptive refresh rate that ranges from 1Hz to 120Hz.
The Samsung Galaxy S24 weighs 168 grams.
The Samsung Galaxy S24 uses a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 chip in most markets (Exynos 2400 in some regions), paired with 8GB of RAM in the base configuration.
The Samsung Galaxy S24 has a 50MP main camera as part of a triple rear camera system.
The MacBook Air 13-inch M3 starts at $1,099 for the base configuration with 8GB of RAM and 256GB of storage.
The MacBook Air 13-inch M3 has a 52.6 watt-hour battery, rated by Apple for up to 18 hours of movie playback or up to 15 hours of wireless web browsing.
The MacBook Air 13-inch M3 weighs about 2.7 pounds (roughly 1.24 kg).
The MacBook Air 13-inch M3 has a 13.6-inch Liquid Retina display at 2560x1664 resolution with 500 nits of peak brightness.
The MacBook Air 13-inch M3 uses Apple's M3 chip, an 8-core-CPU, 8-core-GPU processor built on a 3nm process.
The Dell XPS 13 (2024), in its Snapdragon X Elite configuration, starts at $1,299 with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage.

Independent lab testing measured the Dell XPS 13 (2024) at roughly 14 hours of continuous video playback; Dell's own marketing for a different 2026 configuration cites up to 17 hours of streaming battery life.
The Dell XPS 13 (2024) weighs about 2.6 pounds (roughly 1.18 kg).
The Dell XPS 13 (2024) has a 13.4-inch display at 1920x1200 resolution.
The Dell XPS 13 (2024) has been sold with either an Intel Core Ultra 200V-series processor or, in a separate 2024 model, a Qualcomm Snapdragon X Elite chip.

The best time to visit Jaipur is October to March, when temperatures are cooler and more comfortable for sightseeing; this is also the peak tourist season, with festivals like Diwali and the Jaipur Literature Festival.
Jaipur is cheaper to visit in its off-season, April to June, when summer heat pushes temperatures above 40C but hotel and tour prices drop for budget-conscious travelers.
Amber Fort is commonly recommended as the top attraction to start a Jaipur visit, alongside the City Palace and Hawa Mahal.
Most Jaipur itineraries suggest two to four days to cover the city's major sights.
Kyoto is most scenic in spring (March-May) for cherry blossoms and in autumn for foliage, though winter (December-February) is cheaper for budget travelers.
Daily budgets for Kyoto vary widely by travel style: roughly $40-60 per day for a backpacker, $120-200 per day for a mid-range traveler, and $264 or more per day for a luxury traveler.
Fushimi Inari Shrine, known for its thousands of vermilion torii gates, is free to enter and open 24 hours, and is frequently listed as Kyoto's top attraction.
Most first-time visitors spend three to four days in Kyoto.
Nightly rates at The Oberoi Rajvilas Jaipur vary widely by room type and booking source, roughly $260 to $800 or more per night, with one site reporting an average around $385 in its cheapest month.
The Oberoi Rajvilas Jaipur is a 5-star hotel with a 9.5 ("Wonderful") guest rating based on several hundred reviews.
Amenities include an outdoor pool, a full-service spa, a fitness center, two to three restaurants, and outdoor tennis courts, set across 32 acres of gardens.
The hotel has 71 rooms and suites.
Nightly rates at Ibis Jaipur City Centre are roughly $28-40 per night (about INR 2,300-3,300).
Ibis Jaipur City Centre is a 4-star hotel rated around 4.3 out of 5 based on tens of thousands of guest reviews.
Amenities include a rooftop pool, a 24-hour gym, an on-site restaurant serving Indian cuisine, and a rooftop terrace.
The hotel has approximately 140 rooms.
The AirPods Pro 2 (USB-C model) are priced at $249.
The AirPods Pro 2 offer about 6 hours of listening per charge with noise cancellation on, plus roughly 30 hours total using the charging case.
The AirPods Pro 2 have strong active noise cancellation, though independent reviewers rated Sony's WF-1000XM5 as slightly stronger across the frequency spectrum.
The AirPods Pro 2 support the AAC audio codec; they do not support LDAC or aptX.
The Sony WF-1000XM5 are priced at $299.99.
The Sony WF-1000XM5 offer about 8 hours of listening per charge with noise cancellation on, longer than the AirPods Pro 2's rated single-charge life.
Independent reviewers rate the Sony WF-1000XM5's active noise cancellation as slightly stronger than the AirPods Pro 2's across the frequency spectrum.
The Sony WF-1000XM5 support the LDAC high-resolution codec in addition to AAC and SBC, an advantage over AirPods Pro 2's AAC-only support.
The Burj Khalifa has an architectural height of 828 meters (2,717 feet), or 829.8 meters (2,722 feet) to its very tip.
The Burj Khalifa has 163 floors above ground.
The Burj Khalifa topped out in January 2009 and formally opened in January 2010.
The Burj Khalifa was designed by Adrian Smith of the Chicago-based firm Skidmore, Owings & Merrill.
The Empire State Building's roof is 381 meters (1,250 feet) tall; including its antenna, the tip reaches 443 meters (1,454 feet).
The Empire State Building has 102 floors.
The Empire State Building formally opened on May 1, 1931.
The Empire State Building was designed by the firm Shreve, Lamb and Harmon.
Mount Everest stands 8,849 meters (29,032 feet) above sea level, the highest point on Earth.
Mount Everest is located in the Himalayas, on the border between Nepal and the Tibet Autonomous Region of China.
Mount Everest was first summited on May 29, 1953, by Sir Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay.
K2 stands 8,611 meters (28,251 feet) above sea level, the second-highest mountain on Earth after Everest.
K2 is located in the Karakoram Range, on the border between Pakistan-administered and China-administered territory.
K2 was first summited on July 31, 1954, by Achille Compagnoni and Lino Lacedelli.
India's population is estimated at roughly 1.4 to 1.48 billion people as of 2026, making it the world's most populous country.
India covers a total land area of about 3,287,263 square kilometers.
India's capital is New Delhi.
Hindi and English are India's two official languages at the union level; the constitution additionally recognizes 22 scheduled regional languages.
Japan's population is estimated at roughly 123 million people as of 2026.
Japan covers a total land area of about 377,930 to 377,975 square kilometers.
Japan's capital is Tokyo.
Japanese is Japan's official and national language.
The Nike Pegasus 41 is priced around $130-145.
The Nike Pegasus 41 weighs about 10.0 ounces (men's size 9), with a 37mm heel and 27mm forefoot stack height.
Independent reviewers rate the Nike Pegasus 41's cushioning as moderate (around 3 out of 5), built on a responsive ReactX foam midsole.
The Nike Pegasus 41 is best suited to daily training and tempo-leaning efforts, favoring runners who prefer a firmer, more traditional ride.
The Hoka Clifton 9 is priced around $150.
The Hoka Clifton 9 weighs about 9.7 ounces (men's size 9), slightly lighter than the Nike Pegasus 41.
Independent reviewers rate the Hoka Clifton line's cushioning as maximal (around 5 out of 5), with a high stack height for extra protection.
The Hoka Clifton 9 is best suited to long runs and easy mileage, favoring runners who prioritize joint protection over a responsive feel.
The 2026 Tesla Model 3 starts around $37,000 to $44,000 depending on trim and market.
The Tesla Model 3's EPA-estimated range runs roughly 309 to 363 miles depending on trim.
The Tesla Model 3's battery capacity varies by trim and market, from about 60 kWh up to 82 kWh (78 kWh usable).
The Tesla Model 3 suits buyers prioritizing maximum range, faster Supercharger-network charging, and quicker acceleration.
The redesigned 2026 Nissan Leaf starts around $29,990.
The redesigned 2026 Nissan Leaf's EPA-estimated range runs roughly 259 to 303 miles depending on trim.
The redesigned 2026 Nissan Leaf uses a 75 kWh battery in most trims, with an entry-level 52 kWh version also offered.
The Nissan Leaf suits budget-conscious buyers prioritizing a lower purchase price over maximum range.

To replace a flat car tire safely, pull over on firm ground, use the parking brake, and loosen the lug nuts before lifting the car at its specified jacking point. Remove the flat, fit the spare, lower the vehicle, then tighten the lug nuts in a cross pattern.

In the 2008 musical Mamma Mia!, Sophie prepares to marry on a Greek island and secretly invites three men from her mother Donna's past, hoping to identify which one is her father. Their arrival unsettles Donna and revives old relationships around the wedding.

The 1997 film Titanic follows Jack, a poor artist, and Rose, a wealthy young woman, who fall in love aboard the ill-fated ocean liner on its maiden voyage. Their romance unfolds as the ship strikes an iceberg and sinks, forcing a desperate fight to survive.

The Bose QuietComfort Ultra earbuds deliver class-leading active noise cancellation, with reviewers noting they quiet low-frequency cabin and traffic noise more aggressively than most rivals while keeping voices natural.

Kangchenjunga, the world's third-highest mountain, saw its first ascent in 1955 by a British expedition, when Joe Brown and George Band reached the summit, stopping just short of the very top out of respect for local beliefs.
The Google Pixel 8 uses a 50-megapixel main camera sensor, and reviewers praised its computational photography for sharp, well-exposed shots in low light.
The Google Pixel 8 has a 6.2-inch OLED display with a 120 Hz adaptive refresh rate, giving smooth scrolling that scales down to save battery.
A typical trip to Bali lasts about seven to ten days, enough time to combine the southern beaches with the temples and rice terraces around Ubud.
